data.name: Welcome_Tip1

data.name: Welcome_Tip2
data.value: • Ctrl+Alt+Y opens and closes it from anywhere.

data.name: Welcome_Tip3
data.value: • Drag files onto the notch to keep them on the shelf.

data.name: Welcome_Tip4
data.value: • In Tasks, a time at the end becomes a reminder: “Call Ana at 3pm”.

data.value: Google Calendar and Tasks are further down, under Google.

data.value: Location is turned off for desktop apps.

data.value: Warn me when rain is coming

data.value: When the chance goes over 60% in the next 2 hours.

data.value: Let programs on this PC show activities

data.name: Settings_ActivitiesHint
data.value: Scripts, builds and AI agents can show their progress beside the notch with yata-cli. Only programs running as you on this PC; nothing goes over the network.

data.name: Agents_Note
data.value: Shows in the notch when the agent is working, waiting for you and done. Yata adds its hooks to the agent's own settings, keeps a copy of the file (.yata-backup), and turning off removes only what it added.

data.name: Agents_OnCodex
data.value: On. In Codex, review and trust the hooks with /hooks.

data.name: Agents_ByPlugin
data.value: On through the Yata plugin for Claude Code

data.name: Agents_CursorNoWaiting
data.value: Cursor has no event for "waiting for your approval": it shows working and done.

data.name: Agents_WslHint
data.value: Choose the distros where Claude Code should show in the notch.

data.name: Agents_WslNone
data.value: No WSL distro with Claude Code

data.name: Agents_PathHint
data.value: So scripts and Codex can call yata-cli by name. Terminals already open don't see the change.

data.name: Agents_NoCli
data.value: yata-cli.exe isn't next to Yata (a development build?).

data.name: Agents_Unreadable
data.value: Couldn't read {0}. Fix it, or add the hooks by hand (yata-cli hook setup).

data.name: Agents_NotAnObject
data.value: {0} isn't a JSON object, so Yata leaves it alone.

data.name: Spotify_Note
data.value: Optional. Play, pause, skip, seek, lyrics and the player volume already work without it, free accounts too. Connecting adds like, shuffle and repeat. Spotify doesn't share app keys: create an app at developer.spotify.com (its owner needs Premium; up to 5 users per app, added under User Management), add the redirect URI below, choose "Web API", then paste the app's Client ID here.
